To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Modern management practices are profitable and can be adopted in a short period of time, but informational barriers and limited competition prevent many Indian firms from adopting them.

1) modern management is a profitable technology, 2) firms do not adopt it because it is not widely diffused, 3) the lack of diffusion is due to informational barriers and 4) competition is limited because entry and growth is constrained.
Modern management practices raise productivity and profitability, and are adopted when firms have access to good information about the practices.
